name: wraithbox-doc
comment:scripts: build runs with --force, which clears the content layer cache first, so
every page is rendered again and the reference check of
src/plugins/remark-refs.mjs sees each one. Without it, a build after
`astro check` (mise run ci, the CI Docs job) reuses the pages that the
check rendered, records no failures, and passes content that fails the
fresh build of the Pages deploy.
comment:overrides: Security floors for transitive deps. Each is the patched release on the
SAME major the consumers already require, so no consumer sees a breaking
change: nanoid 3.x for postcss (4+ is ESM-only), js-yaml 4.x for astro and
starlight, fast-uri 3.x for ajv, undici 8.x for unifont, zod 4.x for
@astrojs/sitemap. Drop an entry once every consumer's own range has moved
past the floor and `bun audit` stays clean without it.
GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8, GHSA-5p4m-2wfm-xmqj, GHSA-7p8r-x3mc-p8w7.
The fast-uri floor is 3.1.9 for GHSA-5jgf-p345-68v8, GHSA-f65p-4m7j-42xc,
GHSA-fph4-wmhf-6fwf, GHSA-jqff-g426-hqxp, GHSA-hrr3-gc8f-f4qj,
GHSA-333x-w4r6-6crp, GHSA-w74x-v6f9-j3xg, GHSA-wjr9-j795-jxcr and
GHSA-xhq7-xmqj-769h. The js-yaml floor is 4.3.2 for GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh.
svgo 4.x (astro) is floored at 4.1.0 for GHSA-4vpr-x523-8j87 and
GHSA-w27v-7q3p-w38r. The undici floor is 8.12.2 for GHSA-4qv8-2p9j-2685,
GHSA-f72v-6w45-q472 and GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c, and the zod floor is 4.6.6
for GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5.
postcss-nested is the one exception to the same-major rule: it is moved
from 6.x to 7.x because every 6.x requires postcss-selector-parser ^6 and
no 6.x release fixes GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf, while postcss-nested 7.x requires
^7 (8.x is ESM-only). @expressive-code/core, its only consumer, still asks
for ^6.0.1 in its latest release, 0.44.2. postcss-selector-parser is floored
at 7.1.6, the fixed release.
